required_before_scoring: Verify per-table endpoint column, direction, units, normalization and censoring from original sources; save a versioned endpoint dictionary before parsing values
Map experimental parent H/L sequences to observed coordinates and Chothia positions using sequences only; report gaps and ambiguity
Resolve AAYL structure provenance and shared-parent assignment; never label unverified coordinates as experimental structures
Document 5a12_vegf chain metadata conflict and inspect interface without a result-dependent chain change
Count all eligible H3-only variants and assay/lineage/antigen components before scores; report feasibility without a confirmatory power claim

inclusion.source_set: all listed and metadata-mapped tables in fixed revision; report missing files explicitly
inclusion.primary_mutations: one or more substitutions confined to Chothia H3 positions 93-102; no other H/L changes relative to the experimental parent
inclusion.fixed_backbone: same parent backbone for all variants of an assay; no indels, unmapped substitutions or noncanonical residues
inclusion.antigen: experimental target must map to structure; strain mismatches are flagged, not silently treated as matched
inclusion.non_H3_or_LC_only: report counts and exclusion reasons; do not change the H3-only method to fit these variants
inclusion.unresolved_structure_or_endpoint: exclude from scored subset with explicit reason, retain in accounting

endpoints.direct_Kd: rank by -log10(Kd in molar) only when raw positive physical Kd and units are verified
endpoints.AlphaSeq: separate assay-derived affinity-estimate stratum, not a direct biophysical Kd measurement
endpoints.enrichment: separate enrichment stratum, higher verified enrichment is better
endpoints.already_transformed_score: use verified direction without applying log twice
endpoints.censored: retain flags; exclude censored numerical pseudo-values from primary continuous correlation, report excluded fraction and label restriction; no substitution by detection limit
endpoints.duplicates: same H/L, antigen and experimental condition is one entity; aggregate genuine technical replicates with median on verified transformed scale; retain between-study values separately

scores.primary: unchanged H3 ECLS = apo H3 NLL minus complex H3 NLL; larger is better
scores.model: existing ProteinMPNN v48_020 backbone-only conditional probabilities
scores.seed_behavior: direct API explicit seeds; upstream CLI seed=0 random fallback forbidden

analysis.within_assay: Spearman correlation with average ranks for ties; ECLS minus negative-complex-NLL correlation is primary paired contrast
analysis.constant_score_or_endpoint: undefined correlation reported as NA with tie and variance diagnostics; never silently remove from accounting or treat as successful
analysis.aggregation: within assay, then lineage/antigen components; equal component weights and separate endpoint strata, never pool all mutant rows as independent
analysis.small_component_count: descriptive results only; no confirmatory superiority or cross-antigen significance claim
analysis.uncertainty: do not use a mutant-row bootstrap to claim independent antigen generalization
analysis.independence: report original MMseqs screen and additional short-sequence sensitivity separately; no post-result threshold changes
